model_comparison.name: Compact attribute CNN
model_comparison.advantages: Trainable on personal examples; reports class confidence; existing project-pretrained checkpoint
model_comparison.disadvantages: Depends on segmentation; domain shift; confidence is not calibrated accuracy
model_comparison.resources: TensorFlow/Keras; local checkpoint; 113,558 parameters; modest object crops
model_comparison.project_fit: Chosen: reuses the project's attribute model and supports before/after fine-tuning

model_comparison.name: MobileNetV2
model_comparison.task: General image classification / transferable image features
model_comparison.advantages: Compact general-purpose architecture; official Keras implementation; transferable features
model_comparison.disadvantages: ImageNet labels do not directly classify this project's geometric shapes; requires a new task head and labeled adaptation
model_comparison.resources: TensorFlow/Keras; additional weights if ImageNet initialization is used
model_comparison.project_fit: Considered, not trained or benchmarked here; less direct reuse than the existing narrow shape CNN

model_comparison.name: OpenCV geometric classifier
model_comparison.advantages: Local, deterministic, lightweight; no training data or neural weights
model_comparison.disadvantages: Fixed geometry rules; broken/merged contours and irregular drawings can fail
model_comparison.project_fit: Existing geometric alternative and useful baseline; cannot be fine-tuned with gradients

training.adaptation: Only the shape head is fine-tuned; visual features and fill head are frozen.
limitations: Synthetic demo images are drawings, not real photographs; use personal photographs for the assignment.
Head fine-tuning does not guarantee an improvement on unseen photographs.
Exact duplicate pixels are grouped; independently edited copies must be excluded before import.
